sonnet.problem: Moses appears in the opening card with no short label saying who he is. Each lesson stands on its own, so the baker may not know him.
sonnet.rule: New people. The first time someone shows up, he says simply who they are, like "Cyrus, king of Persia" or "Moses, Israel's leader." "The first time" means the first time in this passage. Each lesson stands on its own

sonnet.problem: The choice card asks what God will do to the six nations, which is the violent act itself (annihilate them). It does not ask about the choices or results around it.
sonnet.rule: Choice cards ask about the choices and results around them, never the act itself.
